changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE source_feeds ADD CONSTRAINT source_feeds_ck1 CHECK ( frequency IN ('WEEKLY', 'MONTHLY') AND aggregation_method IN ('OFFICIAL_STATISTICS', 'STATION_SAMPLE_MEAN') AND update_status IN ('READY', 'DELAYED', 'UNAVAILABLE', 'UNKNOWN') );
ALTER TABLE source_feeds ADD CONSTRAINT source_feeds_ck2 CHECK ( (aggregation_method = 'OFFICIAL_STATISTICS' AND sampling_policy_code IS NULL) OR (aggregation_method = 'STATION_SAMPLE_MEAN' AND sampling_policy_code IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(sampling_policy_code)) > 0) );

changeSet.author: fuel-calc
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE import_runs ADD CONSTRAINT import_runs_ck1 CHECK ( status IN ('RUNNING', 'SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED') AND imported_count >= 0 AND rejected_count >= 0 );
ALTER TABLE import_runs ADD CONSTRAINT import_runs_ck2 CHECK ( (status = 'RUNNING' AND finished_at IS NULL) OR (status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED') AND finished_at IS NOT NULL AND finished_at >= started_at) );

changeSet.author: fuel-calc
fuel-calc
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE price_periods ADD CONSTRAINT price_periods_ck1 CHECK ( basis = 'REGIONAL_CONSUMER_AVERAGE' AND frequency IN ('WEEKLY', 'MONTHLY') );
ALTER TABLE price_periods ADD CONSTRAINT price_periods_ck2 CHECK ( (frequency = 'WEEKLY' AND ((start_date IS NULL AND end_date IS NULL) OR (start_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date IS NOT NULL AND start_date <= reference_date AND reference_date <= end_date))) OR (frequency = 'MONTHLY' AND start_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date IS NOT NULL AND start_date = date_trunc('month', start_date::timestamp)::date AND end_date = (start_date + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day')::date AND reference_date = end_date) );

changeSet.author: fuel-calc
fuel-calc
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE regional_price_observations ADD CONSTRAINT regional_price_observations_ck1 CHECK ( price_rub_per_liter >= 0 AND price_rub_per_liter NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric) AND length(price_rub_per_liter::text) <= 64 );
